simple.summary: פַּחַז (pachaz) means ebullition , i.e. froth (figuratively, lust) First listed occurrence: Gen 49 4.

definitions.full: H6349. pachaz מַּ֫חַז noun [masculine] wantonness, recklessness, unbridled license ; — Gen 49:4 , abstract for concrete (+ כַּמַּיִם like [boiling, or overflowing] water ).
